# Gregor Egan

> Portfolio of Gregor Egan, a photographer, graphic designer and sound artist from Chicago, based in Los Angeles. Digital and film photography, book and graphic design, and dark psychedelic techno.

He specializes in portraits, cityscapes and landscapes, and experimental long-exposure work. He designs books and brands, and co-runs Audiospatials, an independent record label, with Hunter Bowersmith. Contact: gregor.art@pm.me.

## Photography

- [Photos](https://gregoregan.com/photos): digital, analog and selected projects
- [Digital](https://gregoregan.com/digital): portraits, cityscapes and personal work made in Los Angeles
- [Analog](https://gregoregan.com/analog): film photography, 35mm and medium format
- [Selected Projects](https://gregoregan.com/projects): photography projects, including portraits of Tunde Adebimpe and Croz Boyce

## Design

- [Design](https://gregoregan.com/design): graphic design and art direction: album art, book covers, typography and apparel
- [Book Design](https://gregoregan.com/book-design): photo books he laid out, sequenced and typeset
- [From the Archives: Analog Photography](https://gregoregan.com/from-the-archives): a 74-page book of his film photographs, 2020–2025, readable page by page on the site
- [TMWRK artist work](https://gregoregan.com/artists): design for TMWRK Management artists, including Diplo, Dillstradamus and Sierra Hull

## Music

- [Music](https://gregoregan.com/music): hypnotic, textural techno as an LA producer and DJ
- [Gregor Egan on Audiospatials](https://audiospatials.com/gregor-egan): his artist page and releases on Audiospatials

## About

- [About](https://gregoregan.com/about): bio and links

## Notes

- The photographer, designer and producer are the same person.
- Selected Projects (Tunde Adebimpe, Croz Boyce) is his own photography, not TMWRK work.
